card.name: Opening bracket before 'see' cross-references
card.fires_on: The opening square bracket that follows the end of a sentence or clause and begins a cross-reference such as [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)]. It appears in drug-label text.

modes.label: Bracket before section cross-reference
modes.description: An opening bracket right after a clinical statement, followed by 'see' and a label section name.

card.writes: It promotes closing brackets and braces and suppresses closing parentheses, so it expects a bracketed reference to be closed.
card.plain: It marks the opening bracket of a 'see section X' pointer at the end of a label sentence.
